query.description: what to look for, in plain words (several labels: one per line)

cutout.description: path to an RGBA PNG at the original size, ready to use

instances.description: box and alpha per instance; alpha = path to 8-bit alpha PNG

tool.name: remove_background
tool.description: Remove the background from an image and get a transparent PNG cutout. Soft edges: hair, fur, glass. Say what to keep in query, or leave it empty for the main subject. Set output_path to save the cutout there.
tool.returns: Returns cutout: path to an RGBA PNG at the original size, ready to use. The background is transparent, edges and see-through areas keep partial transparency, and solid areas are about 254 of 255, which is normal. Also model and seconds.
